description: Unit test class for SudoRetrieveThingStrategy, testing its behavior with various scenarios involving retrieving a thing with different headers, schema versions, and fields.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SudoRetrieveThingStrategy, extending AbstractCommandStrategyTest and containing multiple tests for different retrieval scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SudoRetrieveThingStrategy object before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the strategy class is immutable.

methods.name: isNotDefinedForDeviantThingIds
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy is not defined for invalid/deviant Thing IDs.

methods.name: isNotDefinedIfContextHasNoThing
methods.description: Ensures strategy is not defined if the context does not have a Thing.

methods.name: isDefinedIfContextHasThingAndThingIdsAreEqual
methods.description: Checks that strategy is defined when context has a matching Thing ID.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Thing without specifying particular fields, expecting full data.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutSelectedFieldsWithOriginalSchemaVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieval with original schema version headers.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval with specific fields selected.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithSelectedFieldsWithOriginalSchemaVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieval with selected fields and original schema headers.

methods.name: unhandledReturnsThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Checks that an exception is thrown when retrieval is not accessible.
